title: Blaze pipeline: intermittent decoder-output PCC~0 on Kimi-K2.6 padded chunked prefill (no-trace, dense path)
body:
### Summary

`Kimi-K2.6-1T chunked prefill padded accuracy 15k@5k (no trace) [bh_sc1]` intermittently returns **uncorrelated decoder output** (`decoder-output min PCC -0.001204 < 0.88`) on the blaze prefill pipeline, on current main-era bases. Kimi-K2.6 is **dense MLA** (no DSA indexer), so this is a dense-path correctness flap.

### Evidence

Across four dispatches of the pipeline on two branches whose diffs are provably unreachable from Kimi's graph (dense model; the branch only touches the DSA indexer path) plus pristine main:

| run | Kimi padded accuracy (no trace) |
|---|---|
| [branch run 1](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/actions/runs/32382113328) | FAIL (job summary shows test passed once on retry, job failed in post-step) |
| [main control](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/actions/runs/32386664431) | flapped attempt-1, recovered on retry |
| [branch targeted-2](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/actions/runs/32434028112) | **FAIL — PCC -0.0012** |
| [branch targeted-3](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/actions/runs/32440047786) | flapping across attempts |

The trace variant of the same test is consistently green — because the traced harness asserts **KV-cache PCC only**, while the no-trace variant additionally PCCs each layer's decoder output (`test_prefill_transformer_chunked.py` "UNTRACED ONLY" block). i.e. the corruption hits hidden states while leaving the KV stem intact, and trace lanes are structurally blind to it.

### Suspects

Intermittent + padded-path + recent onset points at the recent main window: `ttnn.pad` rank>4 change (#52870) or the 2026-08-19/20 UMD bumps. The same window also shows a ~20% no-trace perf regression on the Kimi chunked perf lane (host-dispatch-bound path; possibly the same cause or the documented per-chunk variance).

### Why this matters

An intermittent PCC≈0 on a dense production model's accuracy lane both (a) masks real regressions via retry-to-green, and (b) suggests a live correctness hazard in padded chunked prefill. Worth a bisect over the suspect window on a quiet `bh_sc1` machine.
